| Category = Rice recipes
| Yield = About 3 cups cooked rice
| Difficulty = 3
}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 1½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (360 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) sweet glutinous [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]] (''mochi gome'')
* Water

== Procedure ==

# Place sweet glutinous rice in a medium bowl. 
# Wash rice thoroughly in cool water, rinsing and repeating until water is clear, drain, then return rice to bowl. 
# Add 3 cups (720 ml) water to the rice. Soak for 6 hours or overnight.
# Drain well, spread rice evenly in a round, 8–9 [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (20 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) shallow baking pan, and add ⅓ cup (80 ml) water.
# In a [[Cookbook:Wok|wok]], bring about 4 cups (950 ml) water to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] over medium high heat.
# Place a [[Cookbook:Steamer|steamer tray]] in the wok. 
# Cover the pan of rice and place on the tray over the boiling water. 
# [[Cookbook:Steaming|Steam]] for 30 minutes. If rice is not tender, sprinkle with 2–3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] of water, and steam it for 5 minutes more.
# When tender, remove steamer tray from wok.
